#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Comprehensive test to validate the fix works correctly"""

from sepal_ui import sepalwidgets as sw

def test_backward_compatibility():
    """Ensure 0-1 range still works as before"""
    print("=== Backward Compatibility Test ===")
    
    alert = sw.Alert()
    alert.update_progress(0.5)
    print(f"Progress 0.5: n={alert.progress_bar.n}, total={alert.progress_bar.total}")
    assert alert.progress_bar.n == 50
    assert alert.progress_bar.total == 100
    
    alert.update_progress(1.0)
    print(f"Progress 1.0: n={alert.progress_bar.n}, total={alert.progress_bar.total}")
    # Bar should be closed now
    print("Bar closed successfully")
    
def test_absolute_values_no_total():
    """Test absolute values when no explicit total is provided"""
    print("\n=== Absolute Values No Total Test ===")
    
    alert = sw.Alert()
    alert.update_progress(75)
    print(f"Progress 75: n={alert.progress_bar.n}, total={alert.progress_bar.total}")
    assert alert.progress_bar.n == 75
    assert alert.progress_bar.total == 75  # Total should be set to progress value
    
    # Test completion
    alert.update_progress(75)  # Same value, should close
    print("Bar closed successfully")

def test_explicit_total():
    """Test when explicit total is provided"""
    print("\n=== Explicit Total Test ===")
    
    alert = sw.Alert()
    alert.update_progress(25, total=100)
    print(f"Progress 25/100: n={alert.progress_bar.n}, total={alert.progress_bar.total}")
    assert alert.progress_bar.n == 25
    assert alert.progress_bar.total == 100
    
    # Update to completion
    alert.update_progress(100, total=100)
    print("Bar closed successfully")

def test_large_numbers():
    """Test with large numbers"""
    print("\n=== Large Numbers Test ===")
    
    alert = sw.Alert()
    alert.update_progress(1500, total=2000)
    print(f"Progress 1500/2000: n={alert.progress_bar.n}, total={alert.progress_bar.total}")
    assert alert.progress_bar.n == 1500
    assert alert.progress_bar.total == 2000

def test_fractional_values():
    """Test fractional absolute values"""
    print("\n=== Fractional Values Test ===")
    
    alert = sw.Alert()
    alert.update_progress(3.14, total=10)
    print(f"Progress 3.14/10: n={alert.progress_bar.n}, total={alert.progress_bar.total}")
    assert alert.progress_bar.n == 3.14
    assert alert.progress_bar.total == 10

if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_backward_compatibility()
    test_absolute_values_no_total()
    test_explicit_total()
    test_large_numbers()
    test_fractional_values()
    print("\n✅ All comprehensive tests passed!")
